dict.string: Apple Bridge sends messages, edits notes and drafts mail when you or your agent ask.
Apple Bridge shows names instead of phone numbers and finds the people you mention.
Apple Bridge reads your events and adds new ones when you ask.
Apple Bridge reads your lists and adds or completes reminders when you ask.
Apple Bridge tells your agent where you are when you ask.
